package.name: rm_base
package.description: ROBOT. Mecanum base driver. Replaces the vendor Mcnamu_driver_X3: owns the base-board serial, drives raw PWM (bypassing the broken firmware speed PID), and republishes IMU / voltage / corrected vel_raw. Runs open loop or, with control_mode:=closed_loop, closes the speed loop in ROS on the sign-corrected encoders.
